label: Referrer name, role and organisation
note: Renders in plan consultation - 'who you spoke to'.

label: Health screen - danger or RRP identified
note: Conditional. Shown only when RRP is identified or immediate danger is flagged. Distinct from health.record.

label: Health conditions
note: Sourced from other providers' documents via the source register.

label: Placement and service stability
note: Informs strategy authoring. Does not render in the plan - strategies are based on it, it is not restated.

label: Observable family present
note: yes | no | unanswered. 'unanswered' must survive downstream as a stated assessment gap.

label: What this looks like for this participant
What people currently do in response
Setting events
note: Informs strategy authoring. Does not render in the plan.

label: Practitioner conclusion, confidence and limitations
note: Hard clinical gate. Approval here sets fba.approved.

label: Temporary safeguard rationale (unassessed)
note: Explicitly labelled unassessed. Requires a disposition before a Comprehensive can release.

label: RRP status
note: none | possible_unclear | confirmed. Practitioner-authored. No keyword or checkbox may set this.

label: Practitioner triage outcome
note: accept | request_information | waitlist | decline. Never algorithmic.

label: Risk rating
note: DERIVED, read-only: likelihood x consequence. Display only. MD-019 - it must not gate, rank or set the pathway. triage.rrp_status and triage.outcome stay practitioner-authored regardless of this number.
